Title: Hostile Takeover, Ousting and Ash Heaps

Messages.Author: Jeff Kuta
Messages.Body:
Meth A plays Hostile Takeover and wins Vamp B from Meth B.
Meth B is later ousted.
Vamp B is burned while in Meth A's torpor region. Where does Vamp B
go?

Meth A's ash heap or Meth B's ash heap and therefore removed from the
game?

Thanks in advance.

Jeff

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
